_note: Example manifest only. No real local paths, protected paths, or URLs. Do not use as a production config.

split_plan.generator_holdout: held-out generator for unseen generalization evaluation
split_plan.model_name_holdout: held-out model_name for fine-grained generalization check
split_plan.compeval_eval: CommunityForensics-Eval CompEval split as external evaluation set

notes: Exact model attribution is out of scope. Provenance uses coarse architecture-based family labels only.
architecture metadata is the primary supervision for family labels.
model_name and subset are for distribution analysis and holdout planning only.
Prefer generator-holdout or model_name-holdout over random split to prevent train/validation leakage.
